LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.6: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing in Grade 5 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can varying sentence structures improve your writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to a recording and write down a list of food items eaten at different meal times (红 薯、面包、鸡蛋、奶茶、米饭 、饼、炖 豆、炖牛肉、蔬菜),

2. look at a list of words in a crossword puzzle and circle out nouns, then use them to write simple sentences,

3. work with peers to rearrange the words and phrases provided to make correct sentences,

4. use the sentence starter given to complete the text in a coherent manner,

5. make a balanced meal from the list of food items provided in terms of the different times of the day (早饭、午饭、晚饭),

6. use pictures/drawings and simple sentences to create a simple description of their favourite dishes,

7. team up with peers to discuss the importance of eating a balanced diet.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to a recording and write down a list of food items eaten at different meal times (红 薯、面包、鸡蛋、奶茶、米饭 、饼、炖 豆、炖牛肉、蔬菜),
2. look at a list of words in a crossword puzzle and circle out nouns, then use them to write simple sentences,
3. work with peers to rearrange the words and phrases provided to make correct sentences,
4. use the sentence starter given to complete the text in a coherent manner,
5. make a balanced meal from the list of food items provided in terms of the different times of the day (早饭、午饭、晚饭),
6. use pictures/drawings and simple sentences to create a simple description of their favourite dishes,
7. team up with peers to discuss the importance of eating a balanced diet.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: Teamwork skills are developed when the learner participates actively in rearranging the

words and phrases provided to make correct sentences.

Values:
Integrity: The learner displays honesty when they pick different food items from the list to make a balanced meal.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Health education: Healthy living is promoted as the learner discusses the importance of eating a balanced diet with peers.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner links their learning to Agriculture and Nutrition on the concept of eating a balanced diet for wellness.
